about: One entry per ticket. The Kanban on the canvas (page Kanban) and the handover read this file. States: later (one line, an idea), next (brainstormed, Milan's answer in, no board), now (board drawn and approved, waits for Go), progress (branch open), done (merged, with its version). Milan says the word; Claude moves the card.

home.name: Home page
home.why: The pitch to new beta testers and to a hiring manager reading the PM: what Chef Mealan is, who is behind it, try it here.

setup.name: Setup
setup.why: Profile, goal, lifestyle, training week, shop: nothing locked, every change kept, what is missing said in one row.

plate.name: Plate
plate.why: The editor of a meal: one question at a time, a plate that ends, Chef Mealan's checks said once.

cook.name: Recipes and cooking
cook.why: Recipes for reading and deciding; cooking one step at a time, read aloud, a second phone on the counter.

coach.name: Coach
coach.why: A coach's clients in one tab, each client's page with everything about them; the person keeps their five tabs.

explorer.name: Explorer
explorer.why: Nutrition explained with the app's own letters, one page per topic, wellness language, never a health claim.

trust.name: Trust and privacy
trust.why: Age, consent, the privacy tracker, the disclaimer, the rulebook: what the app may say and keep.

lang.name: Languages
lang.why: English first; Serbian and German next; food names already carry the local name by region.

ops.name: Measuring and releases
ops.why: Metrics, evals, walkthroughs and the releases page: how we know the app works and what shipped.
